task_contract.source_text: This video is recorded using a WidowX robotic arm (Single-Arm) equipped with a normal camera at the head view. The robot's left arm moves to grasp a brown cardboard box, which is initially resting on top of a toy stove. The gripper fully closes to secure the box, and the arm lifts it slightly before moving it to the right side of the stove. Throughout this process, the right arm remains stationary and does not interact with any objects. The cardboard box, marked with black tape and an Amazon Prime label, is successfully relocated without any abnormal situations occurring. In the background, various toy kitchen items, including a green apple and colorful bowls, are visible on the right side of the stove, while the stove itself, with its white and beige plastic design and digital display, remains a fixed element in the scene.[SCENE]: The robot operates in a kitchen setting, with bright and uniform lighting illuminating the workspace. The primary objects include a white and beige plastic toy stove positioned centrally, on top of which the cardboard box is initially placed. Surrounding the stove are various toy kitchen items, such as a green apple and blue and orange bowls, arranged on the right side. The environment is tidy, with no clutter obstructing the robot’s movement, and the overall layout suggests a child’s play area or a simulated kitchen setup for robotic manipulation tasks.

observations.description: 画面中心是一个白色台面、棕黄色边框的线圈炉灶；棕色纸箱始终压在炉灶中前部灶眼区域，箱下露出褶皱的布/纸状物。左侧灶眼盘着黑色线缆；右侧灶眼放有两个白色小卷状物体、叠放的浅棕色条状物和小块方形物；炉灶右外侧可见橙色杯，更右侧水槽/边台区域有绿色圆物。所有采样帧中，纸箱、炉灶旋钮、黑色线缆、橙色杯和绿色圆物的相对位置基本保持不变，未见纸箱被抬起、搬运或放置到炉灶右侧的可见位移。
图像整体存在较明显模糊；纸箱顶面/侧面可见黑色印刷条带与深色胶带状痕迹，但Amazon Prime标签文字或标志在所有可见帧中都不能清晰辨识。画面左上方持续有一团浅灰色模糊形态，无法稳定识别为机器人左臂/夹爪的明确结构，也看不到其与纸箱形成清晰夹持接触。

task_assessment.reason: 核心任务要求左臂抓取纸箱、夹爪固定后抬起并移动到炉灶右侧，但所有采样帧中纸箱始终停在炉灶中部灶眼上，未见有效抬起或搬运到右侧的末态；左上模糊团块不能证明完成了抓取动作。右臂状态及夹爪闭合因视角/模糊不可确认，且即便炉灶主体保持在原位，也无法弥补核心搬运结果未发生。

physics_assessment.reason: 虽然画面模糊且物体几乎静止，但没有出现可确认的穿模、悬浮、瞬移或明显非因果运动；纸箱和杂物持续位于炉灶面上，相对位置稳定。缺少清晰机器人动作细节主要由画质和采样限制导致，不构成已确认的物理异常。
